verdict.rationale: The skills live in a public GitHub repo whose SKILL.md files are directly readable as raw files (ledger-tasks, ralph-loop, understand-project). Installs are interactive and per-skill selectable. A local checkout can be validated in an isolated config before touching normal settings, and the update flow flags differing or unrecorded copies for review rather than silently overwriting them. Missing for 10: a documented pre-install command that lists every file and script a skill adds, an explicit inventory of installed file locations for post-install reading, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the review workflow.
